name: patterson-labs
description: Patterson Labs incubation marketplace. Experimental plugins graduate here before earning durable status in patterson-corp — see docs/promotion-path.md.

plugins.name: patterson-workflows
plugins.description: A conversational interview skill that designs one complete GitHub Agentic Workflow (gh aw) `.md` file from a stated goal — trigger, scope, data strategy, guardrails, network, and engine. Harvested from patterson-skills. Relevant to engineers, SREs, and platform roles designing a new Agentic Workflow before writing the .md file, or clear on the automation goal but unsure of gh-aw syntax.

plugins.name: patterson-design-imports
plugins.description: Design tokens imported from the Patterson Academy and lab-workshop claude.ai/design projects. Each ships a Tailwind v4 theme.css, a W3C tokens.json, a byte-identical generator and a drift check, with every conflict against the 2025 Brand Guide recorded and the Brand Guide winning. Incubating: neither import supersedes patterson-brand, and the supersession ruling is still open. Relevant to designers and engineers styling a training deck, lab workbook or workshop app, matching the live Patterson type scale, or comparing the two imported design systems against each other or against patterson-brand.
